title: Refer-a-Friend | Embrace Healthcare
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Refer-a-Friend We have range of healthcare jobs available and are always on the lookout for qualified, talented, and professional staff. We often find the very best source of new talent is from our nurses, carers and allied health staff introducing their friends to Embrace Healthcare Solutions (EHS). That’s why we introduced the EHS Refer-a-Friend program. If you enjoy working for EHS, tell your friends about your experience. If they do decide to sign up, you will receive a $150 retail voucher as a referral thank you from us. *Conditions apply. See below. Refer-a-friend and be rewarded!* * Terms and conditions apply. See below Your details 🇦🇺 +61 + Add item Your friend's details 🇦🇺 +61 + Add item *The $250 referral is effective as of 1 February 2023. Both referrer and referred candidate are required to complete a minimum of 80 hours work with EHS to receive the gift voucher. Vouchers are issued at the end of each month based on the number of hours worked in the preceding month. If a total of 80 hours has not been worked within the month, eligibility will be re-assessed at the end of the following next month. Send Message
